channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: A.P. Health Minister orders action against doctors and staff for remaining absent from duties
IMD forecasts heavy rain in north coastal Andhra; Vizianagaram, Srikakulam on alert
item.description: Steady showers from Srikakulam to Anakapalli since Monday evening bring relief after days of heat; the IMD expects heavy to very heavy rain on Tuesday and Wednesday and winds of 40 to 60 kmph along the coast

item.title: Pimpri-Chinchwad police identifies 30 Bangladeshi nationals illegally staying since May 2025; 26 deported
item.description: Police said the operations are part of a continuing drive following a Union Home Ministry circular dated May 2, 2025

item.title: Karnataka to track cancer patients after fake drug bust
item.description: In order to make it easy for laboratories, doctors, and pharmaceutical firms to differentiate between fake and original drugs, the department has written to the headquarters of Pfizer to release their reference standards, says Health Minister U.T. Khader

item.title: Tamil Nadu government hospitals running short of critical medicines for pre-term babies
item.description: Surfactant medicines are essential to inflate the lungs of pre-term babies in need of the therapy. Inquiries with a number of hospitals and doctors reveal that a number of centres have been facing short supply of surfactant drugs

item.title: KSRTC bus catches fire at Pattambi in Keralam
item.description: Passengers quickly got off the bus with the help of people from nearby market. None injured

item.title: Researchers at RGCB in Keralam develop nanopore sensors for early detection of Parkinson’s disease
item.description: RGCB team designs ‘self-assembling dual-diameter’ nanopore sensors that are capable of detecting biomarkers linked to neurodegenerative diseases with high sensitivity

item.title: Two infants killed in fire accident at Telangana’s RIMS Adilabad hospital SNCU ward, 25 children rescued
item.description: Telangana Chief Minister orders an inquiry into the incident and directed officials to submit a report on the causes of the fire

item.title: Minor girl gang-raped at Astha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir in Delhi by men posing as policemen; friend assaulted
item.description: Three men allegedly posed as policemen before taking the 17-year-old and her male friend to a secluded spot in the South Delhi park; one accused later injured in encounter.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh extends A4 liquor shop renewal deadline by two days to September 23
item.description: Of 3,650 shops notified for 2026-27, 3,173 have opted for renewal and 2,726 have paid in full or part; ₹257 crore of the ₹933.44 crore renewal demand is yet to come in

item.title: Supreme Court orders fresh probe into 2012 rape-murder near Dharmasthala in Karnataka
item.description: Top court directs State to constitute a tech-savvy and efficient SIT without any officer from the old probe team and complete the investigation within three months; lone accused in case was acquitted by CBI court in 2023

item.title: CM Vijay launches expanded Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme
item.description: The expansion will benefit around 15.3 lakh students studying in Classes VI to VIII across 15,454 government and government-aided schools in the State

item.title: The arithmetic of Tamil Nadu’s growth ambition
item.description: But, the State’s growth trajectory will determine when it reaches its $1.5 trillion ambition

item.title: Jaishankar urges reformed multilateralism amid rising geopolitical tensions
item.description: Speaking at the P4M Summit in New York, S. Jaishankar said multilateralism must be reinforced to address emerging global challenges

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay reviews preparations for expansion of Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme
item.description: CM Vijay will launch the expansion of the scheme at a school in Tiruvanmiyur in Chennai on September 22

item.title: Where Kolkata’s hilsa comes from and why its waters may shape its taste
item.description: Is Ganga hilsa really different from Padma hilsa? What is Gujarat hilsa doing in Kolkata’s markets, and why did old Calcutta connoisseurs claim they could taste the stretch of river a fish came from? Following the hilsa from ocean to river to plate reveals a story of ecology, appetite and inherited taste

item.title: Pawan Kalyan inaugurates ₹9.59-crore drinking water scheme serving 52 habitations in Pithapuram
item.description: The three-decade-old scheme at Nagulapalli, which had stopped reaching tail-end villages, has been modernised to supply safe water to 97,000 people in Kakinada district

item.title: Karnataka HC orders court-monitored probe into KPSC irregularities; sets up SIT headed by DGP Alok Kumar
item.description: While giving 100 days for the SIT to complete investigation and submit final report, the Court also directed it to submit an investigation progress report every 30 days

item.title: KPSC veterinary officer recruitment scam: CID probe reveals money trail, question-paper leak network in Karnataka
item.description: Investigators have established links between candidates, a set of intermediaries, former KPSC Controller of Examinations IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar and a key intermediary Basavaraj Kannale

item.title: Dalits threaten State-wide campaign, protests against government of Karnataka
item.description: They want the government to come out with guidelines for allotment of ‘DC Manna’ (depressed classes) land to SCs and STs

item.title: Survey discovers six new species from Periyar Tiger Reserve in Keralam
item.description: Four-day faunal survey records six species previously undocumented in the reserve, including one bird, one butterfly, and four odonate species

item.title: What is scrub typhus | Explained
item.description: Scrub typhus is a bacterial infection caused by the bacteria Orientia tsutsugamushi. It is spread by the bite of infected larval mites or chiggers -- it is not a mosquito-borne disease.

item.title: Google to report child abuse content directly to Indian authorities
item.description: The decision comes after two Indian government sources told Reuters they had in recent weeks ‌pressed tech companies like Google and Microsoft to report child abuse content concerning India directly

item.title: Why is NCPCR investigating Meta, Instagram?
item.description: Under what powers can the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights summon social media platforms and other companies?

item.title: Meta to share child safety information directly with Indian agencies
item.description: So far, this information has been shared with the U.S.-based National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, which has in turn shared India-specific CSAM reports with the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB)

item.title: Aadhaar card not valid document to determine age: Supreme Court
item.description: A bench comprising Justices Sanjay Karol and Ujjal Bhuyan said the age of the deceased person had to be determined from the date of birth mentioned in the school leaving certificate.

item.title: Karnataka tightens marriage registration rules, says Aadhaar cannot be age proof
item.description: The direction came in the light of incidents where the age in the Aadhaar card and birth certificate were mismatched, resulting in child marriage.

item.title: 'Historic occasion': Jaishankar describes first V4+India Foreign Ministers meeting
item.description: The Visegrad Group (V4) is a cultural and political alliance of the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, and Slovakia that aims at advancing co-operation in military, economic, cultural and energy affairs

item.title: Supreme Court issues notice on plea in sinking of MSC Elsa 3
item.description: A Bench headed by Justice K.V. Viswanathan sought a response from Elsa 3 Maritime Inc., the company that owned the vessel

item.title: GST rate cuts have been offset by ‘galloping’ inflation: Congress
item.description: The prices of several consumer goods had returned to nearly their pre-GST cut levels without any significant increase in consumption, the Congress spokesman claimed

item.title: Former V-P Hamid Ansari’s remarks exposed ‘Muslim League-Maoist character’ of Congress, says BJP
item.description: At an event commemorating late constitutional expert A.G. Noorani, Hamid Ansari had referred to former PM’s view saying that ‘the real danger to India was not communism, but Hindu right-wing communalism’, citing Noorani’s book The RSS: A Menace to India

item.title: Academicians write to Governor opposing the inter-university transfer of teachers
item.description: The West Bengal Universities and Colleges (Administration and Regulation) Bill seeks to add one provision in Section 14A of the existing 2017 Act, which will allow inter-university transfer of both teaching and non-teaching employees as and when required, officials said

item.title: 100% drought likely to be declared in Maharashtra by month-end, says Minister
item.description: Never seen such severe dry spell: Cooperation Minister Babasaheb Patil; he adds govt. has initiated measures such as fee waiver for students, electricity bill waiver, and deployment of water tankers

item.title: Burglars steal service pistol, 30 live cartridges, jewellery and cash from Nanded head constable’s home
item.description: A case was registered at Nanded Rural Police Station on September 19, 2026, under Sections 331(4) and 305 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita

item.title: Revision of bus fares in Tamil Nadu: Madras High Court grants four more weeks for the government to take final call
item.description: The fare was fixed last at the rate of ₹0.58 per km in 2018 when price of diesel was ₹67.50 per litre as against the current price of around ₹100 a litre

item.title: Next panchayat election only after the delimitation: Samrat Choudhary
item.description: He urged three-tier Panchayat representatives to suggest ways to improve village infrastructure. He asserted that work would be undertaken to establish a Panchayat for a population of approximately 7,500.

item.title: NCW takes suo motu cognizance of Jamui incident
item.description: The National Commission for Women has taken suo motu cognisance of an incident in Jamui district of Bihar involving alleged public molestation, assault, forcible stopping and harassment of a teenage girl and her male companion, NCW said

item.title: BJP wins six of seven mayoral polls in Rajasthan; Congress cries foul
item.description: The BJP defeated the Congress in Alwar, Udaipur, Pali and Ajmer, while its candidates were elected unopposed in Bharatpur and Bhilwara; the only consolation for Congress came in Bikaner

item.title: Mahayuti Minister Mangal Prabhat Lodha is suppressing voice of community members, alleges Jain Monk
item.description: ‘I spoke to State Assembly Speaker Rahul Narvekar and told him if the issue is not resolved, I will stage protest outside the Godiji Parshvanath Jain temple in Mumbai’s Paydhuni,’ said Muni Nileshchandra

item.title: Court orders fresh hearing in Sonia Gandhi’s voter roll entry case
item.description: Special Judge Vishal Gogne said that a Magisterial Court, instead of considering the core aspect of whether the complaint disclosed commission of a cognisable offence, digressed towards the issue of citizenship

item.title: Class 10 girl and boy returning from coaching groped and assaulted in Bihar’s Jamui, sparking a political row
item.description: Police register suo motu FIR, arrest three as viral video of crime sparks political row; NCW directs support for teens, says steps should be taken to stop video circulation; Rahul Gandhi slams patriarchy; Tejashwi says Bihar put to shame by NDA govt.

item.title: SBSP chief Rajbhar’s claim on U.P. division ignites fresh debate as opposition hit out at NDA
item.description: ‘Once the caste census is completed, there will be no problem in carrying out the division; we will divide the State after the caste census; this is what the Prime Minister of the country said,’ Om Prakash Rajbhar says

item.title: Union Minister Shivraj Chouhan accuses Punjab government of sheltering drug peddlers
item.description: Today, Punjab has got the ‘MOD Model’ — Model of Drug Development; the AAP is running a government of crime, corruption and commission in Punjab, said Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan

item.title: Plea in M.P. High Court seeks closure of Ladli Behna scheme over its financial cost; notice issued to government
item.description: ₹1,500 is not enough to run a household, and there is no study to show that it is helping women create long-term financial opportunities, said Sudha Dubey

item.title: Party-backed councillors detained in Haryana ahead of Rajasthan local body poll, alleges Congress
item.description: The councillors were returning from Himachal Pradesh, where the party had moved them in a bid to prevent defections ahead of the election

item.title: J&K House Committee finds ‘irregularities’ in Jal Jeevan Mission, calls for probe
item.description: While some progress has been achieved in certain areas as far as implementation of JJM is concerned, yet the overall objective of the Mission has remained unachieved, said NC legislator Hasnain Masoodi

item.title: BDCC bank waiting for govt. sanction for recruitment, says MLA
Belagavi students trained by zilla panchayat get into premier institutions
Ram Temple donations theft case: SIT report finds 105 instances of unauthorised currency removal
item.description: Solicitor General Tushar Mehta, appearing for Uttar Pradesh, says probe has been “substantially concluded” and a charge sheet will be filed before the court of Additional Sessions Judge on or before September 25, 2026

item.title: New checklist by Keralam research team records 3,261 flowering plant species in Agasthyamalai Biosphere Reserve
item.description: Compilation by team from Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden and Research Institute seeks to reaffirm global significance of Western Ghats as a biodiversity hotspot and need for focused, region-specific strategies for protecting it

item.title: ASR Collector reviews ‘Trishul’ strategy against crime in district
Six arrested within 24 hours for ₹40-lakh Kalyan robbery; cash, motorcycles worth ₹36.48 lakh recovered
item.description: The Crime Branch traced the accused through technical analysis and informants and recovered cash and two motorcycles together valued at ₹36.48 lakh

item.title: Assembly witnesses blame game on origin of Kasturirangan report
G. Palanithurai appointed Adviser to Minister Anand
Getting away from gunshots
item.description: For many young Israelis, Dharamkot in Himachal Pradesh offers an escape from the pressures of military service and conflict, drawing them to India’s Hummus Trail, in search of peace and healing. Though there has been a marginal dip in visitors after the war, locals in the tranquil Himalayan retreat worry about over tourism, drug use, and rave culture, finds Vikas Vasudeva

item.title: It may be time for Thirumavalavan to lead alliance in 2031: VCK general secretary
Tamil Nadu bypolls: After DMK’s plaint to EC, TVK drops leaders of alliance parties from star campaigner list
item.description: The TVK has named leaders of its alliance partners in its list of star campaigners for the Madurantakam and Dharapuram bypolls

item.title: SFI begins indefinite sit-in protest at Savitribai Phule Pune University over ₹10 increase in meal charges
item.description: The protest was launched after a delegation of students met SPPU Vice-Chancellor Suresh Gosavi on September 21, 2026 and sought the immediate withdrawal of the increase

item.title: Assistant professor recruitment candidates demand independent panel for re-evaluating papers
item.description: They demand that the panel contain subject matter experts who have experience in assessment and pedagogy to re-evaluate the answer papers, in addition to a statistician

item.title: Tamil Nadu explains to Cauvery Authority the rationale behind its demand for clearing backlog of 16 tmc ft
item.description: It says the demand is based on the principle of pro-rata share in the flows realised. The Cauvery tribunal and the SC had referred to the concept of pro-rata for adoption in times of distress
